title.narrative: Supporting the Effective Implementation of Turkish Constitutional Court Judgments in the Field of Fundamental Rights

description.narrative: Overall objective is to contribute to effective implementation of European standards in the field of human rights, including on gender equality. Specific objective is to ensure the effective implementation of TCC judgments in the field of human rights within the scope of individual application mechanism and better awareness of relevant stakeholders on the TCC case law and individual application mechanism.
